_comment: Clerk Billing config for Flowstarter (B2C user plans). Apply with: `clerk config patch --file apps/flowstarter-main/clerk-billing.json` (after `clerk auth login` + `clerk link`). Slugs MUST match PlanKey in apps/flowstarter-editor/server/src/usage/planEntitlements.ts so the billing webhook can mirror plan -> workspaces.tier_name. Amounts in minor units (cents), EUR. Dev instance uses Clerk's dev billing gateway (no Stripe needed); prod connects Stripe. Billing APIs are experimental — verify field names against `clerk config pull --keys billing` before applying.
